quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence or production, and footprint or consumption accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS 24 July 2026 correction notices are preserved and superseded statements are not treated as current evidence.
DfT SAF and RTFO fifth-provisional publications remain provisional; November 2026 final data are not treated as already observed.
Vehicle registrations and vehicle stock remain activity or stock measures rather than direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants and product eligibility remain scheme-administration evidence rather than measured greenhouse-gas reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors and UK ETS country-specific factors remain reporting or calculation tools rather than direct measurements.
Local-authority aggregates and Defra consumption footprints are not assigned to individual parcels.
No future release announcement, policy target, allowance price, certificate count or scheme uptake metric is converted into a parcel emissions value.
No individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
